I need to focus on margin bands based on developer instructions, prioritizing them over win rates. I need to adopt default margin bands for contracts: major overhauls should be +3–5% over the finance baseline, multi-year maintenance frameworks at +1–2%, and spare parts supply at +1–2%. rounds.response:
1) Default margin bands: overhauls (lump‑sum) +3–5% over finance baseline; multi‑year maintenance frameworks +1–2%; spare‑parts supply +1–2%; inspections/recurring low‑intensity visits +2–3%; emergency attendance fees +3% with +50% after‑hours surcharge.

3) Payment and security: milestone‑linked payments for large projects, net 45 days, and only the minimum performance bond/retention required by the tender.  
4) Capacity rules: do not bid on any new medium/large contract if projected peak‑month spare capacity <20% (accept only negligible/low‑intensity call‑offs); if spare capacity is 20–40% consider one medium bid at upper margin band; only pursue multiple medium/large bids when spare capacity >40%.
